understanding.goal_understanding: Solve each level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable at the same time; completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) in the chosen direction unless blocked by walls/boundaries or other objects; some adjacent objects are pushable and can be moved along when pushed. Levels can have multiple selectable pieces, and control is switched by CLICKing the exact pixel/grid position of another selectable. The movement_blocked flags are only hints (adjacent-object detection) and don’t guarantee whether a move will succeed.
